title: Boosted Charger Session Completion Rate
dataSources: Rides (`ride:session`), charge sessions (`ride:charge`), ride exports (`ride:export`), surf forecasts (`surf:forecast`), ride incidents (`ride:incident`), segment efforts (`fitness:segment`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sports telemetry — Onewheel ride exports, legacy Boosted board logs, Surfline forecast snapshots, and Strava segment efforts — streamed to Splunk HEC via vendor exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ride:charge platform="boosted" charger_type=* charge_completed=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(charge_completed="yes",1,0))) as matched by charger_type
| eval a_full_charge_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_full_charge_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Boosted charge sessions that end with a full charge by charger type.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which charger type are helping or hurting Boosted charge sessions.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a full charge` on `ride:charge` events and summarize the hit rate by `charger_type`.
visualization: Table of charger type with percentage of Boosted charge sessions ending with a full charge.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how often a full charge happens for each charger type so you can see where Boosted charge sessions go smoothly or get stuck.
